Name: King's Highway
ModernLocation: Transjordan (the ancient highway through Edom and Moab)
Description: The great north-south road through Edom and Moab along which Israel asked leave to pass, promising to keep to the road, drink no well water, and turn neither right nor left; Edom refused, and Israel went around.
BiblicalSignificance: The King's Highway is where Israel's politeness met Edom's refusal, and the long way round became part of the wilderness story. The KJV spells it 'king's high way.'
